# Overview
A time-off request app for a small company.

# Personas
- Employee — requests time off and checks their remaining balance.
- Manager — reviews and approves or rejects requests from their team.

# Features
- An employee requests time off for specific dates.
- An employee sees how much leave they have left.
- A manager sees pending requests from their team.
- A manager approves or rejects a request.
- Everyone sees the status of their own requests.
